threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You order a coffee and ask for ‘regular’ size—locals just know it’s all about the flat white.
Caught a bloke on the 3 bus singing opera at 2 AM. Stopped at Clapham North and the driver joined in. Full-on performance; passengers were loving it.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a street vendor selling fresh borscht next to a tattoo parlor at 2 AM. Only in Neukölln do you find that blend of culture and chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a trampoline park in a former textile factory, where kids bounce while parents sip coffee amidst vintage decor.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their ability to navigate BART delays and reroute to the 14 or 49 without batting an eyelash. Tourists just stand there confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today that stopped for a whole minute while a pigeon seemed to deliberate its next move on the tracks. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists don't realize that the locals avoid the main squares like Plaça del Sol during peak hours—it's packed with people and overpriced drinks.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a recent arrival by their puzzled look at the metro map, still holding onto their tourist map while locals navigate seamlessly.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Tube.' Locals just refer to it as 'the Overground'—and get ready to argue about it!
Heard a guy on the 133 last night passionately arguing with his phone about whether vegan cheese counts as real cheese. Must've missed the stop.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when the sound of a street musician playing a violin at 3 AM was just the background to my midnight kebab run.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you catch a spontaneous techno party in a laundromat while waiting for your spin cycle to finish.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can tell you the exact time the BART breakdown will screw their evening plans, without even checking the app.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the bus at 2 AM, sipping a drink from a paper bag. Only in the Tenderloin would a night out end like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think they can just grab a sandwich and head to the park. Little do they know, locals have secret spots for fresh bread that are miles away from the tourist traps.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they try to order a 'café con leche' at 5 PM—seriously, the local baristas brace themselves.
